## Goal
`tests/codex/test_cx_name_variants.py:143-148` and WO-233 test selected pairs through the matcher. Nothing checks the whole `GROUPS` table (`src/freemyid/engine/nicknames.py:17-94`) against the module's own promises.

## Order
Start after WO-233 is merged (its matcher tests read this table).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Every name is lower-case ASCII letters only (the promise at 16), with no surrounding spaces; no group repeats a name; every group has at least two names; the formal names (first entries) are unique.
2. For every pair in every group, each name is in the other's `expand` (symmetry, 101-112); `expand(x)` contains `x`; `expand("")` is empty; an unknown name expands to itself only; `expand("  bob ")` equals `expand("bob")`.
3. No chaining (docstring 5-6): for every name, `expand` equals the union of the groups that contain it, never a name reachable only through a second group.
4. `groups_of(x)` (124-127) is exactly the set of first entries of the groups containing `x`.
5. Any table defect found is fixed in `nicknames.py`. New groups only for very common US given names, each with a public source named in a comment, and never one that would merge two existing groups; the SEC-103 ambiguity rules in the matcher docstring (`src/freemyid/engine/matcher.py:15-19`) must still hold (matcher tests pass).

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them.
